meta.label: ACT ONE
rules: the picture is cut to the stick timeline: its beats are the shots, its lines are the lines, nothing re-timed
a continuation beat that follows its own shot directly merges into it
a line starts on the frame in which its first sound falls (beat start + t; t may be negative, a pre-lap), ends after the frame of its last sound
mouths and words on the same rule; a line appears in every shot it sounds in (carry = runs in from an earlier shot, pre = starts under this one before its own)
marks come from the stick's own sound spots and text, the takes' words, or a base lock's marks scaled to the new length
the framing decides who shows a mouth (face), not the take's lip_sync flag
meta.note: Nothing here was watched or heard. The numbers are measured from the files; whether the picture reads needs a person.

lines.text: gerg wants to ship it. rima wants it quiet. alyi wants to know what it is first.
Okay, the build's green. I'm shipping it.
We said low-key, Gerg. I underlined it. Twice.
she'll go for three.
It's a research preview, Rima. Nobody reads research. We'll get forty users and a nice thread.
Then let's treat it like one. One little post, no press. And a banner that says it makes things up.
It'll have a banner. Nobody reads banners either.
Mas, it's your call. If it breaks in front of people, and it will, what do we tell them?
she's right. it will break. i don't know which part yet.
it's a preview.
Okay. Say it works. Say people actually use it. That's going to cost us a fortune.
That's a v2 problem.
And what if it wakes up?
…still a preview.
alyi asks that about everything we build. he means it every time.
It's all staged on my end. Your button.
Six years and eleven months. From the day we started to that click.
you counted.
Someone should.
let's see if anyone notices.
So we've launched autocomplete.
Autocomplete that read the internet, Rima. All of it.
What a great question!
Nobody asked one.
Brilliant! You're clearly a visionary.
it likes me.
It likes everyone. It called my variable names inspired.
i know. i still read it twice.
someone noticed.
Low-key.
Very low. Basement.
A million people, Mas. You're actually crying for them.
it's the bill.
mostly the bill.
Everyone, it's fine. Let's take this offline.
We heard the siren. Is it search? Is search all right?
Search is fine. Totally fine. It's just a chat thing, people seem to like talking to it.
Someone else built that? It looks like our work.
It is ours. We published it.
Do we still have badges?
eleven keys. he's here for the twelfth.
Mas, we're very pleased. It's a partnership.
It's stuck.
It's long-term.
That collar suits you.
it does.
and the rent?

Oh, we don't think of it as rent. Everything you build, you'll build on our servers, as many as you like, for as long as you like. We'll keep the lights on and the floors warm. You keep doing whatever it is you do upstairs at night.
that's a lot of servers.
Everyone is welcome. Rent is due on the first.
That's our model in your search engine. Are you really going after Elgoog with it?
Oh, yes. "…I want people to know that we made them dance…"
ours does that too.
mario used to sit where gerg sits. he left to build a careful one.
Memo, on race dynamics. Point one: we must not launch on the same day as them. That's how a race starts.
You're absolutely right!
Addendum.
Great sign. Love the font.
It's not the font, Nole. We're asking every lab to pause for six months.
Next quarter.
